title: Add AI-generated Board edit proposals
summary: Unbounded AI changes would be difficult to preview, validate, undo, attribute or safely apply. Add a provider-neutral BoardEditProposal contract that can only emit validated BoardCommands with rationale, scope, confidence and before/after diff; keep execution human-confirmed.
acceptance_criteria: A provider-neutral BoardEditProposal contains requested scope, rationale, confidence, warnings and validated BoardCommands only.
AI output is decoded into a strict schema and rejected when it references unknown objects, unsupported commands or stale document revisions.
The user always sees a before/after Board diff and explicitly accepts, edits or rejects the proposal.
Accepting an AI proposal creates the same transaction/history/proposal evidence as a human edit.
Prompts and provider responses never receive repository secrets, bookmark data or unrelated Board content.
A fake provider and deterministic fixtures test success, partial rejection, invalid schema and cancellation.
No source-code or design.json write-back is introduced in this ticket.

evidence.note: Every authoring change is currently proposal-first and traceable.
Intent, rationale, structured targets and acceptance notes are already separated.
Future apply is expected to verify proposals before mutation.

blocked_by.reason: Required Board foundation must be solved first.

trigger.source_ref: HumbleStudio Board architecture finding HS-BAR-011, requested by Jan.

commands: xcodebuild -project HumbleStudio.xcodeproj -scheme HumbleStudioMac -configuration Debug CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
agent_notes: Board changes must remain proposal-first and must not mutate source truth unless a future separately accepted apply contract permits it.
Do not broaden this slice into real-time collaboration, arbitrary source rewrite or a provider-specific AI architecture.
Rejected alternative: Let AI rewrite BoardDocument JSON directly — It bypasses command validation, undo and review.
